steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each contract is placed by its end date and its notice date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Notice date within 90 days
findings.fix: Decide renew or exit before the notice date

findings.title: Contract with no end date
findings.fix: Set the end date from the signed copy

outcome.notChecked: Terms not in the register, and any amendment not recorded.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] contract-a-90d.md:12  Notice date within 90 days.
       Fix: Decide renew or exit before the notice date.
[medium] contract-e-no-end.md:19  Contract with no end date.
       Fix: Set the end date from the signed copy.
[low] contract-f-no-owner.md:26  Contract with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Terms not in the register, and any amendment not recorded.
pros: Checks a notice date within 90 days; a notice date already passed on a contract that auto-renews; a contract with no end date, no notice period or no owner; an auto-renewal with no stated renewal term.
cons: Not checked: Terms not in the register, and any amendment not recorded.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-neg-contract-renewal-calendar skill on the records for this review.
